Open_Button drives the door open until Open_Limit is reached

Close_Button drives the door closed until Closed_Limit is reached

Cycle starts automatically when Car_Present is detected and Start_Button is pressed

Wash_Pump runs for 20 seconds, then Rinse_Valve runs for 15 seconds, then Dryer_Fan runs for 10 seconds

Cycle_Complete turns on once drying finishes and resets when the car leaves

Car_Present: %IX9.0
Start_Button: %IX9.1
Wash_Pump: %QX9.0
Rinse_Valve: %QX9.1
Dryer_Fan: %QX9.2

Box_Sensor counts boxes passing on the line

Pusher_Cylinder pulses for 1 second every time 5 boxes have been counted, then the count resets

Box_Count_Display shows the running count since the last pallet push

Box_Sensor: %IX10.0
Pusher_Cylinder: %QX10.0
Box_Count_Display: %QW40

Photo_Eye triggers a weight check of the part currently on the scale

Reject_Pusher pulses for 500ms whenever Weight_Input is outside +/-5 of Target_Weight

Weight_Input: %IW41
Target_Weight: %IW42
Photo_Eye: %IX11.0
Reject_Pusher: %QX11.0

Heater turns on when Temp_Sensor drops 5 degrees below Setpoint

Heater turns off when Temp_Sensor rises 5 degrees above Setpoint

Temp_Sensor: %IW50
Setpoint: %IW51
Heater: %QX12.0

Temp_Sensor reads process temperature in tenths of a degree

Fan1 turns on above 30.0C and off below 28.0C

Fan2 turns on above 35.0C and off below 33.0C

Fan2: %QX13.1

Compressor_Motor starts when Pressure_Sensor falls below 80 psi

Damper_Position is fully closed (0%) when CO2_Sensor is at or below 600ppm

Damper_Position is fully open (100%) when CO2_Sensor is at or above 1000ppm

Damper_Position scales proportionally between those two points

CO2_Sensor: %IW54
Damper_Position: %QW54

Irrigation_Valve opens for a fixed 10 minutes whenever Soil_Moisture drops below 30% or Manual_Start is pressed
